title: Google: AI features and your website
notes: Google describes normal Search eligibility for AI links, no special AI schema/file requirement, and reporting within Search Console Web traffic. The guide recommends Search Console for diagnosis.

title: Google: Improve local ranking
notes: Local visibility depends on relevance, searcher distance and prominence. Accurate information, reviews and links matter; a website cannot manufacture proximity.

title: Google: Business Profile representation guidelines
notes: Represent the actual business and actual eligible locations. Do not interpret a location page as authorization to create a profile or invent a street address.

title: Google: Search spam policies
notes: Doorways, manipulative links, scaled low-value output and deceptive generative-response manipulation can cause loss of visibility. A disclosed, useful directory differs from a network made primarily to pass ranking credit.

title: Google: LocalBusiness structured data
notes: Use appropriate business markup for real business details. Markup describes visible facts; it is not a substitute for those facts or a ranking guarantee.

title: Rank Expand Academy public offer
notes: Public sales page advertises $99/month, 221+ lessons, microsite builder and niche validator, a backlink rolodex described as 815 sites, AI directory blueprint, workflows and coaching. These are advertised claims, not independently verified contents or outcomes. No private materials accessed.

title: Seed video: 61 AI websites for 40 days
notes: Original upload metadata dated 2026-11-03. Public captions used as source; private contest leaderboard, domains and measurement code not available.

title: Google: Ranking systems, exact-match domain system
notes: Google describes a system intended to avoid excess ranking credit for exact-match domain names.

title: Google Search documentation updates: June 2026
notes: The documentation changelog says FAQ rich results no longer appear and the related documentation was removed. Retain helpful visible answers; do not promise the old feature.

title: Google: Business eligibility and ownership
notes: Google explicitly lists lead-generation agents/companies and online-only businesses as ineligible for Business Profiles.
